in_sanskrit.name: सुभाशा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who brings good news or is an auspicious one

in_hindi.name: सुभाशिनी
in_hindi.meaning: सुभ (subh) - good, आशिनी (āśinī) - one who sits or stays
in_hindi.long_meaning: A woman who stays or exists in a good state

in_tamil.name: சுபகசினி
in_tamil.meaning: சுப் (subh) - good, கசினி (kasini) - one who shines

in_telugu.name: శుభశినీ
in_telugu.meaning: శుభ (subh) - good, శినీ (śinī) - one who exists
in_telugu.long_meaning: A woman who exists in a good state

in_marathi.name: Subhashini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhashini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subha means good or auspicious, Ashini means beginning. The name Subhashini signifies a good start in life.
